name: Nishio Rent All
h1: Consolidating branches, growing the fleet, one view of the work
lede: Nishio is merging offices and folding in acquired rental businesses while investing JPY 120 billion in fleet and growing overseas. Airtable gives merged teams one connected view of enquiries, fleet and jobs.
why_p: Domestic consolidation and overseas expansion both depend on branches and subsidiaries sharing the same picture of customers, assets and projects.

signals.title: Kobe office integrated into Osaka
signals.body: From 1 October 2026 the RA Kobe office was integrated into RA Osaka with the stated aim of further improving operational efficiency.
signals.angle: Reconcile customer enquiries, fleet records and job handovers across merged branches in one place.

signals.title: Shoji folded in from October 2026
signals.body: Kyushu general rental business Shoji Co. is being folded into Nishio Rent All from October 2026, part of a plan targeting JPY 10 billion of annual Kyushu sales within three years.
signals.angle: Run acquisition integration as a tracked programme with owners, milestones and open issues.

signals.title: JPY 120 billion fleet investment
signals.body: Nishio set out JPY 120 billion of rental fleet investment over the three years to September 2028, covering fleet, acquisitions and land for new depots, alongside a target of 250 battery-powered machines.
signals.angle: Track fleet purchases, depot projects and electrification targets against plan in one base.

signals.title: Overseas growth, including Australia
signals.body: Overseas rental revenue is targeted to grow 19 percent to JPY 28.6 billion, with machines bought for Skyreach and Fork Force in Australia relocated to Japan after payback.
signals.angle: Follow each asset's lifecycle across countries and subsidiaries without re-keying data.
